benefits.title: A library worth browsing.
benefits.body: Browse folders as collections. Search your movies, switch views, and add optional TMDB posters, cast, and ratings.

benefits.title: Pick up where you left off.
benefits.body: Resume a cast, manage the queue, and adjust playback from the web panel or your terminal.

benefits.title: Your Mac is the server.
benefits.body: No app to install on the TV. Video travels across your local network, without transcoding.

workflowTitle: From a folder to the sofa.
workflowIntro: Add your movie folders in Settings. Play a file in your default Mac player, or find a TV on the same network and start casting.

tableTitle: Know what your TV can do.
tableIntro: Your TV must support the video and audio formats in the file. TV Cast sends the original file; it does not convert it.
installIntro: Requires macOS, Python 3.9+, uv, and Apple Command Line Tools.

installSteps.title: Install and open
installSteps.body: Starts the service at login and opens the web panel.
installSteps.code:
uv tool install tvcast
tv install
tv ui

installSteps.title: Add your movie folders
installSteps.body: In Settings, add your movie folders. TMDB artwork and details are optional.

installSteps.title: Choose your screen
installSteps.body: Choose Find TVs in the TV tab and allow local-network access. Open a film and select Play on TV.

faqs.q: Do I need a Samsung TV?
faqs.a: No. Casting works with DLNA TVs. Samsung-specific features add remote buttons, text input, and app launching; the base playback controls work over DLNA.

faqs.q: Can I use it without a TV?
faqs.a: Yes. Browse the library and open files in your default Mac player. Local playback does not update TV Cast’s TV resume point or interrupt an active cast.
Video is served from your Mac to your TV over your network. If enabled, TMDB metadata lookups make requests to TMDB for movie information and artwork.

faqs.q: How do I update or remove it?
faqs.a: Stop any active cast first. Run uv tool upgrade tvcast, then tv install to restart the service. To remove it, run tv uninstall before uv tool uninstall tvcast. Settings and playback history are retained.

faqs.q: What if the TV cannot play a file?
faqs.a: TV Cast does not transcode. Install ffmpeg for optional runtime and compatibility checks, and use the troubleshooting guide for discovery, codecs, and subtitle issues.

agentIntro: Use the installed local tv CLI to inspect and control TV Cast. This public website is documentation, not a remote control endpoint.

interactiveDemo: The preview places the real TV Cast panel inside a Mac browser window. Open a film locally to launch a separate mock IINA player, or cast it to the paired Samsung TV. Local playback and TV playback have independent position and play/pause state. Both use poster artwork, without video or audio streaming. The browser never accesses real devices or local files. Reset clears the app, local player, and TV.
